units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) a list of the individual powers of local self-government bodies established by this Federal Law that are to be exercised by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) a list of executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and/or officials appointed by its state authorities that are assigned to exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, with the distribution of those powers among them;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4) the period during which executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, which may not extend beyond the elimination of the circumstances provided for in point 1 of part 1 of this Article;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5) the sources and procedure for financing the temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. In the case provided for in point 2 of part 1 of this Article, a temporary financial administration is introduced in the municipality concerned for up to one year by a decision of the commercial (arbitrazh) court of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, upon a petition by the highest official of that constituent entity and/or the municipal representative body or the head of the municipality.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. A temporary financial administration may not be introduced upon a petition by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation within one year after the municipal representative body assumes its powers.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 6. To restore the municipality’s solvency, the temporary financial administration, in accordance with federal law, takes measures to restructure the municipality’s overdue debts; prepares amendments and additions to the municipal budget for the current financial year and a draft municipal budget for the next financial year; submits them to the municipal representative body for consideration and approval and, in the cases provided for by federal law, to the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for approval by a law of that constituent entity; ensures internal municipal financial control, including control over municipal budget execution in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation; and exercises other powers in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 7. In the case provided for in point 3 of part 1 of this Article, the decision on the temporary exercise by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of individual powers of local self-government bodies is adopted by that constituent entity’s highest executive body, with simultaneous withdrawal of the corresponding subventions.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 8. Decisions of public authorities referred to in this Article may be challenged in court.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 9. The powers of local self-government bodies to adopt a municipal charter, amend and supplement it, establish the structure of local self-government bodies, change the boundaries of the municipality’s territory or transform the municipality may not temporarily be exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 39. Municipal control
units.text: Article 39. Municipal control
units.label: Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Municipal control
units.text: 1. Local self-government bodies organize and exercise municipal control over compliance with requirements established by municipal legal acts adopted on matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and, where federal laws assign the corresponding types of control to local self-government bodies, also municipal control over compliance with requirements established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, taking into account parts 5 and 9 of Article 32 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Municipal control
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies and officials vested with control functions under the municipal charter oversee whether the activities of local self-government bodies and officials comply with the municipal charter and regulatory legal acts of the municipal representative body adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Municipal control
units.text: 3. The organization and exercise of types of municipal control are regulated by the legislation of the Russian Federation on state control (supervision) and municipal control in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities
units.text: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities
units.label: Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities
units.text: 1. The list of indicators for assessing the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities is approved in accordance with a procedure determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities
units.text: 2. Regulatory legal acts of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for grants to municipalities from that constituent entity’s budget to facilitate and/or reward achievement of the best values of the indicators referred to in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Assessment of the effectiveness of local self-government bodies’ activities
units.text: 3. Regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation may provide for interbudgetary transfers from the federal budget to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation to facilitate and/or reward achievement of the best values of indicators of local self-government bodies’ activities, or to reward best practices in organizing municipal administration and resolving matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.label: Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 1. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation supervise compliance by local self-government bodies and local self-government officials with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 2. State bodies authorized under federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation to exercise state control (supervision) over the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, including territorial bodies of federal executive authorities and executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, state control (supervision) bodies), exercise, within their competence, control (supervision) over compliance by local self-government bodies and officials with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and other municipal regulatory legal acts when local self-government bodies exercise powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, other powers and rights assigned to them under federal laws and municipal charters; and over the conformity of municipal legal acts with the requirements of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and municipal charters.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 3. State control (supervision) bodies may not require local self-government bodies or officials to exercise powers that this Federal Law and other federal laws do not assign to the local self-government bodies of the municipality concerned, or to finance the corresponding expenditure from the local budget.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 4. State control (supervision) bodies exercise state control (supervision) over the activities of local self-government bodies and officials on the principles of objectivity, openness and publicity.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 5. In exercising state control (supervision), duplication of the control and supervisory powers of state control (supervision) bodies at different levels is prohibited.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 6. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation coordinate the activities of state control (supervision) bodies in planning and conducting inspections of local self-government bodies and officials.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 7. Scheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials are conducted jointly by state control (supervision) bodies on the basis of an annual inspection plan compiled and approved by the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, the annual plan). A scheduled inspection of the same local self-government body or official may be conducted no more than once every two years.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 8. State control (supervision) bodies submit draft annual plans for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials to the prosecutor’s office of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation no later than 01.09 of the year preceding the inspection year.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 9. The draft annual inspection plans referred to in part 8 of this Article are reviewed by the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to determine whether the inclusion of objects of state control (supervision) is lawful, with proposals to the heads of state control (supervision) bodies for joint scheduled inspections.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 10. On the basis of the draft annual inspection plans submitted by state control (supervision) bodies, the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation compiles the annual plan for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials no later than 01.10 of the year preceding the inspection year.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 11. The annual plan for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials includes the following information:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 1) the names and locations of the local self-government bodies and officials whose activities are to be inspected;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 2) the names of the state control (supervision) bodies planning the inspections;
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 3) the purposes, grounds and dates of the inspections.
units.label: Point 3 Part 11 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 12. The annual plan for inspections of local self-government bodies and officials must be posted on the official websites of the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the relevant state control (supervision) body on the Internet information and telecommunications network no later than 01.11 of the year preceding the inspection year.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 13. Unscheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials are conducted by state control (supervision) bodies on the basis of a decision of the head of the relevant body, approved by the prosecutor’s office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, made on the basis of submissions by citizens and legal entities and information from state bodies concerning violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation that cause emergencies, threaten citizens’ lives and health, or entail mass violations of citizens’ rights.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 14. Unscheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials may also be conducted pursuant to instructions of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, or at the request of the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or the prosecutor of a constituent entity for an unscheduled inspection in the course of supervision of compliance with laws on the basis of materials and submissions received by prosecution authorities, and also to monitor compliance with previously issued orders to remedy identified violations. These inspections are conducted without obtaining approval from the prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 15. Information on scheduled and unscheduled inspections of the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, their results and measures taken to stop identified violations and/or eliminate their consequences must be entered in the Unified Register of Inspections in accordance with the rules for establishing and maintaining that register approved by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 16. A request for information from a state control (supervision) body is addressed to the head of a local self-government body or to a local self-government official, taking their powers into account. The request is directly considered by the head of the local self-government body whose competence covers the matters it contains.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 17. The period set by state control (supervision) bodies for local self-government bodies and officials to provide requested information is at least 10 working days.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 18. The period for providing information may be shortened where violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation causing emergencies, threatening citizens’ lives and health or entailing mass violations of citizens’ rights have been established.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 19. Local self-government bodies and officials may decline to provide information requested by state control (supervision) bodies if it was provided previously, officially published in the mass media or posted on the official website of the local self-government body on the Internet information and telecommunications network. In their reply to the request, the local self-government body or official shall indicate the source where the information was officially published or posted.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 20. When issuing orders to remedy identified violations and setting deadlines for compliance, state control (supervision) bodies must take into account the need for local self-government bodies to comply with the requirements and procedures established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Control and supervision of the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials
units.text: 21. This Article does not apply where federal laws establish another procedure for organizing and conducting control (supervision) over the activities of local self-government bodies and officials, or to control (supervision) measures conducted by officials of federal security service bodies.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 41

units.locator: Chapter 5. Direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: Chapter 5. Direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.label: Chapter 5. Direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.label: Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 1. The forms in which the population directly exercises local self-government include:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 1) a local referendum;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 2) municipal elections;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 3) a citizens’ assembly.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 2. Forms of the population’s participation in the exercise of local self-government include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 1) a survey;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 2) public hearings and public discussions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 3) a citizens’ meeting;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 4) initiative projects;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 5) territorial public self-government;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 6) a rural settlement elder.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 3. In addition to the forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation in its exercise provided for by this Federal Law, citizens may participate in local self-government in other forms that do not conflict with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, this Federal Law, other federal laws or laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 4. Direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation in its exercise are based on the principles of legality and voluntariness.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 5. Public authorities and their officials must assist the population in directly exercising local self-government and participating in its exercise.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 6. Local self-government bodies of urban okrugs and municipal okrugs may, in accordance with municipal charters, decide to involve citizens on a voluntary basis in work of social significance to the urban or municipal okrug (including duty shifts) in order to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 7. Only work that does not require special professional training may be classified as work of social significance.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population and participation of the population in the exercise of local self-government
units.text: 8. Adult residents of urban okrugs and municipal okrugs who are capable of work may be involved in work of social significance, without remuneration and outside their main working or study hours, no more than once every three months. Such work may not last for more than four consecutive hours.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 43. Local referendum
units.text: Article 43. Local referendum
units.label: Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Local referendum
units.text: 1. A local referendum is held for the population to decide directly on matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 43
